contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [IMP] C ALLECTV[S P A]VG ; R/ LAETIT[IA AVG] In

Copper alloy. Coin. Radiate of Allectus (AD 293-296) (Reece Period 14). Obverse description: Radiate and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [IMP] C ALLECTV[S P A]VG Reverse description: Galley right with mast, other details unclear. Reverse inscription: LAETIT[IA AVG] In exergue: (Q)C. C Mint. RIC V, pt 2, p. 569, no. 125. This coin has been considered for Sam Moorhead's corpus for RIC.…
